desc: The Frigidaire 24" Stainless Steel Tub Built-In Dishwasher offers thorough cleaning from corner to corner with our BladeSpray, which provides better water coverage compared to our traditional spray arm. Plus, enjoy an enhanced dry with MaxDry, which delivers better results reducing the need for towel drying.
hl: Unlike traditional spray arms, our BladeSpray® arm rotates in two directions, so you get better water coverage that reaches every corner.
With the fan assisted EvenDry™ system, air flow is evenly circulated and moisture is removed for clean, spot-free dishes every time.
Remove 99.9% of common household bacteria with NSF-Certified Sanitize Option.
Save time loading and unloading and fit more with a third level rack that easily holds silverware, cooking utensils and tools.
Skip pre-rinsing with our DishSense® sensor technology that adjusts cleaning performance based on the soil level of your dishes.
Easily Fit Dishes with Adjustable Racks
Make loading the dishwasher easier with adjustable racks and enough space to fit large dishes.
